categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property registration and land ownership matters, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
